notes: shard ids are the validated bundle's own ids; the trace never restates them
a trace records what was selected, never what should have been selected

each record is one independently sampled context from the M2 fixture; the fixture carries no request identity, so the record order is sorted by (position, layer) and must not be read as a causal token stream
the M2 selector decisions come from a degraded, untrained-router setting; locality conclusions are conditional on a trained router's statistics
